how: Recruitment asks for help with an existing text and proposes anniversary character drawings.
The starter supplies a layout and begins with one character before helpers join.
Helpers accept calls with brief commitments that request nothing back.
Contributors negotiate intended character features through correction and agreement.
Participants report which characters are already placed and where they can be found.
Posted coordinates and a supplied layout locate the work and answer requests for directions.
Placement discussion moves into a temporary chat channel and returns as a retrospective invitation.
Coordinate and template circulation includes handing helpers into live chat for placement discussion.
A participant reports actively defending the design through roughly two accounts each.
Spare-account use must remain distinct from automation when the participant explicitly denies a script.
Vandalism reports and a personal single-pixel repair show maintenance of existing work.
An apparent script is reidentified as active defenders whose disputed colour is subsequently revised.
Maintenance demands cease to describe actionable placement once participants establish that editing has ended.
A treaty inquiry receives a border limit and the organiser's report of contacting neighbouring groups.
The organiser reports communicating with neighbouring groups without exposing the conversations themselves.
Recognising another group's authorship leads a member to withdraw a proposed alteration.
A member proposes converting a neighbouring slogan but withdraws the proposal without reporting execution.
A visiting greeting receives a conditional maintenance offer, while individuals recount defending other works.
Offered maintenance depends on finishing the current work and receiving the neighbour's pixel layout.
Contacts and personal affiliations leave formal coalition formation untestable in the unseen coordination record.
Proximity to other pictures does not establish a host ruling over this work.
Treaty inquiry and a contact report do not reveal whether members contested authority to bind them.
A later location link does not establish relocation after loss or the deliberation behind it.
A wish for a drawing is answered by locating existing art and cannot establish judged incapacity.
Character loyalties enter canvas recruitment as a reason to refuse help and as joking interpretations.
Calling the picture truth invites affirmation and a joking alternative character identification.
A character-based refusal does not disclose an inherited quarrel between rooms.
The record shows preference-based refusal rather than an inherited tie naming an inter-room attack target.
The room stages a fake season announcement, reveals it, and answers a copied joke with criticism.
A recruiter's apology about possible rule-breaking does not establish an actual canvas-specific moderator boundary.
Participants thank contributors and praise the shared effort despite an imperfect final result.
Participants save a history image and circulate images identified as final.
Marking the end includes correcting an ongoing-maintenance claim and receiving explicit acceptance.
A repost dispute selects a finalized image as distinct from an earlier ongoing version.
Version contestation includes defending recirculation of a final state without requiring cleanup of the image.
Seeking prints and reporting posters express carrying the canvas into another form without verifying production.
An existing coordination venue can persist through invitations, navigation help, and a helper's first use.
Anger at unidentified vandalizers does not establish a reciprocal contest with a named rival room.
The global prevalence claim and the completeness of local decided order cannot be tested from unseen chat decisions.
The proposing starter bundles a layout and invitation that helpers explicitly join.
Calls receive bare acceptance while an Emilia appeal receives a reasoned refusal.
A template precedes later design correction and agreement, so posting it is not a necessary settlement endpoint.
Restraint can precede treaty inquiry or follow recognition of authorship without an evidenced settled border agreement.
The same member withdraws a proposed alteration upon recognising the neighbouring work's makers.
Thanks can mark closure of damaged and incomplete work rather than depend on a report of full completion.
Archival saving can precede closure thanks rather than follow celebration as a necessary stage.
Calls and later state reports do not establish that the call caused construction when main coordination is unseen.
A retrospective repair report does not establish the proposed causal transition from building to upkeep.
The treaty exchange does not identify neighbouring erosion as the cause of border talk.
Active spare-account defence is reported without explaining whether insufficient capacity caused its adoption.
Print-seeking follows retrospective discussion without an explicit causal link from recording to reuse.
Neither judged shortage nor rebuilding deliberation can be inferred from a later location report.
An offered favour after a greeting does not establish shortage-driven requests or received help.
Neighbour contact and a later favour offer do not establish a border bargain producing exchanged help.
A later alteration proposal does not establish that recruitment redirected members toward attack.
The withdrawn alteration supplies no evidence that an attack call produced treaty talk.
The withdrawn proposal does not establish an ensuing contest with its identified makers.
Maintenance offers and personal affiliations cannot reveal whether defensive pressure caused coalition formation.
A recruitment apology does not establish a canvas flood or a consequent host boundary response.
A treaty question and contact report do not disclose a consequent dispute over representative authority.
